researchSources.title: Letter from Dennis Cocke to Dr. Gurdev Singh Gill, April 10, 1997
researchSources.publisher: University of the Fraser Valley, South Asian Canadian Digital Archive
researchSources.result: Original April 10, 1997 letter signed by Dennis Cocke as Health Board Chair and headed Simon Fraser Health region. Full page visually inspected. Later legal QA shows this is post-renaming Region evidence, not proof of the predecessor Board’s mark.

researchSources.assessment: Original PDF retrieved and text inspected. Establishes Regional Health Boards Regulation effective December 16, 1996; section 3 rescinds old Simon Fraser and Burnaby board designations on their amalgamation. Does not by itself resolve the exact corporate amalgamation effective day.

Original PDF text inspected and handwritten date visually verified: February 26, 1997. Amends Regional Health Boards Regulation by substituting Simon Fraser Health Board for Simon Fraser/Burnaby Health Board.

Original PDF text inspected and handwritten date visually verified: March 17, 1997. Rescinds B.C. Reg. 56/97 (M88 change) and substitutes Simon Fraser Health Region for Simon Fraser/Burnaby Health Board. Thus the April 10 letter is post-renaming Region evidence.

reviews.notes: An original April 10, 1997 letter on Simon Fraser Health Region letterhead is signed by Dennis Cocke as Simon Fraser Health Board Chair. Further legal QA established this is after the amalgamated body’s Region renaming: M88/1997 (February 26) briefly substituted Simon Fraser Health Board for Simon Fraser/Burnaby Health Board; M111/1997 (March 17) rescinded that change and substituted Simon Fraser Health Region. M432/1996 rescinds the old Simon Fraser and Burnaby Board designations on amalgamation and establishes the new regulatory framework effective December 16, 1996. Consequently this letter is assigned to Simon Fraser Health Region only; it does not establish use by the distinct predecessor Board. Original predecessor artwork remains unresolved.
